patches.author: OpenAI Codex, adapting the repository lean URL quotation proof
patches.origin: rust-cpython/experiments/url-quote-lean-proof/{quote.rs,module.c,build.py} and the pinned Rust-for-CPython source; original build integration authored for this experiment on 2026-09-24; 2026-09-25: registered Modules/_rust_url_quote in configure SRCDIRS so out-of-tree parallel builds create its object directory, and removed the hard-coded aarch64-apple-darwin rustc target
patches.license: PSF-2.0, matching the pinned CPython fork and repository proof
patches.reason: Evaluate guarded exact-bytes URL percent quotation through a CPython-owned C extension and private no_std Rust kernel in the source build.
patches.compatibility: Applies to Rust-for-CPython commit b812b4a7b9efaca46b98544a8633b7d7e454166b with Cargo.lock SHA-256 55f5f3bf547d3b9e7896a5feb6d17aa3b607610c7c21d919164f0877a8d05023; preserves the original urllib.parse guards and fallback, builds the private kernel for Cargo's configured target (the native host when CARGO_TARGET is empty) on the macOS aarch64 and Linux x86_64 lanes with nightly-2026-09-15.
patches.reproducer: Apply to the locked archive with git apply --check, build the pinned Rust candidate, then run the 2,177 public differential cases from rust-cpython/experiments/url-quote-lean-proof/check.py adapted to compare installed candidate and control, plus python3.16 -m test test_urlparse test_urllib -j1.

patches.author: OpenAI Codex
patches.origin: Pinned Rust-for-CPython Modules/zlibmodule.c and libz-rs-sys-cdylib 0.6.7 custom-prefix feature; authored for this experiment on 2026-09-24
patches.license: PSF-2.0, matching the pinned CPython source
patches.reason: Route every CPython inflate stream operation to prefixed zlib-rs symbols while preserving platform zlib for deflate, checksums, and version identity.
patches.compatibility: Applies to Rust-for-CPython commit b812b4a7b9efaca46b98544a8633b7d7e454166b; guarded by PYTHON_BUILD_ZLIB_HYBRID and requires libz-rs-sys-cdylib 0.6.7 custom-prefix with LIBZ_RS_SYS_PREFIX=python_build_rs_.
patches.reproducer: Apply to a fresh extracted pinned source with rust-cpython/build.py source patch checks, inspect the prefixed archive symbols, build --zlib-hybrid, compare 876 encoded bytes with the platform control, and run focused CPython zlib consumer tests.

patches.license: PSF-2.0, matching the pinned CPython source
patches.reason: Route only the local zlib.decompress inflate stream to prefixed zlib-rs while persistent public and private streams remain on platform libz.

patches.author: OpenAI Codex, integrating the repository TAR checksum proof
patches.origin: Pinned Rust-for-CPython tarfile.py and repository TAR checksum proof; authored on 2026-09-25
patches.license: PSF-2.0, matching the pinned CPython fork and repository proof
patches.reason: Optionally route exact 512-byte TAR header checksums to a TAR-owned private no_std Rust extension only when the captured native helpers have their expected type, module, and name and remain unchanged.
patches.compatibility: Applies after 0001, 0002, and 0003 to Rust-for-CPython commit b812b4a7b9efaca46b98544a8633b7d7e454166b; independently selectable with 0004; exact built-in bytes of length 512 only; ordinary Python helper replacements before or after tarfile import use the Python path; lazy import on first eligible checksum; pinned nightly-2026-09-15.
patches.reproducer: Apply selected patches to fresh verified source and check changed paths for default, TAR-only, and URL+TAR; build --tar-checksum; compare complete locked source TAR workload and cold import tarfile with the prior TAR-owned candidate; inspect helper replacement and non-exact fallback boundaries.
